name: SoundEffect
description: Represents the sound effect that accompanies an animation or slide transition in a slide show.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the specified object. Read/write.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Represents the type of sound effect. Read/write.

methods.name: ImportFromFile
methods.description: Specifies the sound that will be played whenever the specified shape is clicked or animated or whenever the specified slide transition occurs.
